title: A new Evia update is ready
details: Converted Bricklayer ST0095 v1.2 into the first self-contained Nisi course pack with all 59 KSBs and the existing 72 learner evidence opportunities
Before an existing Bricklayer learner moves onto the pack, Evia compares the pack with the current built-in course map; any mismatch leaves the existing course untouched
Bricklayer keeps the same evidence, RPL, OTJ, EPA and target storage, and installed course packs can now be exported as .nisi files for induction or distribution
